name: Vaulto: Private AI Voice Notes
subtitle: Voice to text. Local or cloud.
description:
Capture a thought, a list or a meeting. Vaulto turns your recordings into editable notes and helps you organize the result.

VOICE TO TEXT
Record in a note or import an audio file. Use cloud transcription with included free minutes, or download a Whisper model for free on-device transcription. With a downloaded model, speech-to-text works without an internet connection.

YOUR ORIGINAL, ALWAYS AVAILABLE
Clean up wording, summarize, structure a note or extract a checklist. Each AI result is saved as a separate version so you can compare it with the original and switch back. AI can make mistakes: review important details.

LOCAL AI WHEN YOU WANT IT
Download a Qwen model to process text on your device. Model downloads need internet, storage and sufficient memory. Smaller models can be less accurate, and performance depends on your device.

NOTES YOU CAN KEEP
Write with headings and checklists, organize with tags, search your notes and export Markdown. Recover deleted notes from Trash for 30 days.

CLEAR PRIVACY CHOICES
Local processing runs on your device. Cloud processing sends the selected audio or text to our processing service and its AI providers. Encrypted sync is a separate optional feature, available after creating an account with email. Keep your recovery key safe.

You can start taking notes without an account. This initial iOS release is free and does not offer in-app purchases. Cloud features have usage limits; downloaded models can continue working offline.

Privacy: https://vaultonote.com/privacy
Support: https://vaultonote.com/contact
reviewNotes: The initial iOS release is free; no in-app purchases or external purchase links are offered. Start in the guest session to create, edit and record notes without signing in. Optional email sign-up/sign-in enables account features. Settings offers account deletion for signed-in users. On-device transcription and AI require model downloads. Cloud processing has a consent step and free usage limits. Phone-only mode keeps processing on-device, including when a model needs to be downloaded again. AI outputs are separate from the original and may contain errors. A downloaded speech model can transcribe without internet. Hold the microphone button for live dictation or use the recording action. No special hardware is required.
